title: 第21章 猎杀妖兽第22章 嚣张青年
content_zh:
第21章猎杀妖兽
楚风眠选择来到这蛮荒山脉，第一是想要体验生死战斗，利用一场场战斗，来让楚风眠所突破。
第二，也是打算就此机会，磨练剑术，积攒经验。
楚风眠虽然剑意惊人，剑术领悟极高，但是却也多是纸上谈兵，前世楚风眠就连灵力都没有，又怎么可能有过战斗经验。
这十日时间，楚风眠的境界没有丝毫变化，但是论起实力来说，却也足以称得上是进展飞速。
起码楚风眠现在，面对淬骨境八重的妖兽，已经是足以轻易击败，换做武者来说，就算是淬骨境九重的武者，也不可能是楚风眠的对手。
楚风眠有自信，淬骨境九重的武者，三招之类便是足以击败。
“这附近淬骨境八重的妖兽，已经都要被斩杀了，看来要去更深入的地方了。”
楚风眠环视了一圈，便是拿起玄青剑，继续向着蛮荒深处走去。
越是靠近蛮荒深处，其中的妖兽也就越是强大，据说其中甚至还有锻体境，神海境的妖兽。
楚风眠遇到他们，必死无疑，不过这些强大妖兽都是在蛮荒的最深处，不太可能会出现在蛮荒山脉边缘。
楚风眠小心翼翼的走在丛林之中，只见楚风眠锁走出的每一步，都没有丝毫声响。
这边是魅影身法的神奇之处，一道高阶身法，并非是单单在催动之时有用，平时的一举一动，都会有着影响。
像是楚风眠现在，穿梭在丛林之中，都不会发出任何一点声音，正是依赖于魅影身法的神奇。
如此一来，倒是很难惊动一些高阶妖兽。
“这附近，有着妖兽的痕迹。”
楚风眠逐渐的停止了下来，在这附近，楚风眠隐约已经察觉到，有着妖兽存在的痕迹。
“血腥的味道。”
楚风眠鼻子闻了闻。
就在不远处，有着血腥味传来。

“去看看。”
楚风眠心中一定，身形便是悄悄的靠近了过去。
在前方不远处，一只五六米长的巨大犀牛尸体，正在不断的留着鲜血，在这巨大犀牛尸体的旁边，有着十多道红色身影，正在啃噬着这巨大犀牛的尸体。
“双角犀牛？”
看到那巨大犀牛的尸体，楚风眠也稍微有些惊讶。
这双脚犀牛，可是淬骨境九重的妖兽，一身蛮力更是强的吓人，同境界几乎无敌般的存在，如今竟然被猎杀。
在这蛮荒外围，竟然有如此恐怖的妖兽可以做到这一点？
楚风眠心中惊讶之际，有将视线放入到那十多道红色身影身上。
这十多道红色身影都不大，最长不过两米，他们的身上长得厚厚的毛发，鲜红的吓人。
“嗜血魔狼。”
楚风眠心中暗自念了一声。
“也怪不得这双角犀牛，会被猎杀。”
这嗜血魔狼，实力只是淬骨境八重的妖兽，但是嗜血魔狼向来群居，一个族群少则几头，多则十几头。
尤其是嗜血魔狼对敌之时，极为疯狂，十多头嗜血魔狼围攻，就连那双角犀牛也只能被猎杀。
“这群嗜血魔狼，正好足以练就我的剑术！”

Chapter 21 Hunting Monsters
The first reason Chu Fengmian chose to come to this wild mountain range was to experience a life-and-death battle, and to use battle after battle to allow Chu Fengmian to break through.
Secondly, I also plan to take this opportunity to hone my sword skills and accumulate experience.
Although Chu Fengmian's swordsmanship was astonishing and his swordsmanship understanding was extremely high, he was mostly just talking about it on paper. In his previous life, Chu Fengmian didn't even have spiritual power, so how could he have any combat experience.
In these ten days, Chu Fengmian's state has not changed at all, but in terms of strength, it can be said to be rapid progress.
At least Chu Fengmian is now able to easily defeat monsters at the eighth level of the Bone Tempering Realm. As a warrior, even a warrior at the ninth level of the Bone Tempering Realm cannot be Chu Fengmian's opponent.
Chu Fengmian was confident that three moves would be enough to defeat a warrior at the ninth level of the Bone Tempering Realm.
"All the monster beasts at the eighth level of the Bone Tempering Realm nearby have been killed. It seems they are going deeper."
Chu Fengmian looked around, then picked up the Xuan Qing Sword and continued walking towards the depths of the wilderness.
The closer you get to the depths of the wilderness, the more powerful the monsters there are. It is said that there are even monsters in the body forging realm and the divine sea realm.
If Chu Fengmian encounters them, he will definitely die, but these powerful monsters are in the deepest part of the wilderness and are unlikely to appear on the edge of the wilderness mountains.
Chu Fengmian walked cautiously in the jungle. Every step Chu Fengmiansuo took made no sound at all.
Here is the magic of the Phantom Movement. A high-level movement is not only useful when activated, but will have an impact on every move in daily life.
For example, Chu Fengmian is now walking through the jungle without making any sound, relying on the magic of the phantom body technique.
In this way, it would be difficult to alarm some high-level monsters.
"There are traces of monsters around here."
Chu Fengmian gradually stopped. Nearby, Chu Fengmian had vaguely noticed traces of the existence of monsters.
"The smell of blood."
Chu Fengmian sniffed.
Not far away, there was the smell of blood.
"Go and have a look."
Chu Fengmian was certain in his heart and quietly approached.
Not far ahead, a huge rhinoceros carcass five or six meters long was dripping with blood. Next to the huge rhinoceros carcass, there were more than a dozen red figures, gnawing at the huge rhino carcass.
"Two-horned rhinoceros?"
Chu Fengmian was also a little surprised when he saw the huge rhinoceros carcass.
This two-legged rhinoceros is a monster beast at the ninth level of the Bone Tempering Realm. Its brute strength is even more frightening. It is almost invincible in the same realm, but now it is being hunted.
In this wild outskirts, there is such a terrifying monster that can do this?
Chu Fengmian was surprised when he turned his attention to the dozen or so red figures.
These dozen or so red figures are not big, with the longest being no more than two meters. They have thick hair on their bodies, and the scarlet color is scary.
"The bloodthirsty demon wolf."
Chu Fengmian thought to himself secretly.
"No wonder this two-horned rhinoceros is hunted."
This bloodthirsty demonic wolf is only an eighth-level monster of the Bone Tempering Realm, but the bloodthirsty demonic wolves have always lived in groups, with a group ranging from a few to more than a dozen.
Especially when the bloodthirsty demon wolves are fighting against the enemy, they are extremely crazy. More than a dozen bloodthirsty demon wolves are surrounding them, and even the two-horned rhinoceros can only be hunted.
"This group of bloodthirsty demon wolves is just enough to practice my sword skills!"
